name: lightsout
description: Deterministic engine for coding agents — the accountability shell that lets the factory run with the lights off.
author: David Christian

scripts.test: rm -rf .test-dist && esbuild $(find src tests -name '*.test.ts' -not -path '*/node_modules/*') --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --loader:.md=text --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cjsRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __cjsRequire(import.meta.url);" --outbase=. --outdir=.test-dist --log-level=warning && esbuild src/cli/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --loader:.md=text --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cjsRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __cjsRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=.test-dist/cli-under-test.mjs --log-level=warning && node --test ".test-dist/**/*.test.js"
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/cli/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --loader:.md=text --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cjsRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __cjsRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=plugin/dist/cli.mjs
